## Walkthrough

The PR removes the exported HighlyAvailableArbiter feature gate from registration and deletes its entries from multiple FeatureGate payload manifests and the features.md table. Several CRD test files and generated feature-gated CRD manifest entries referencing HighlyAvailableArbiter were removed or updated. Validation annotations for InfrastructureStatus.controlPlaneTopology were simplified to a unified FeatureGateAwareEnum mapping. Multiple CRD and ControllerConfig schema descriptions were extended to document a HighlyAvailableArbiter mode (2 full control-plane nodes + 1 smaller arbiter). A special-case match for arbiter in the featuregate test analyzer was also removed.
